requirements.text: Generate the gate pass directly from the Tally sales invoice in a single click, automatically including the vehicle number without manual retyping.
Enforce that every departing vehicle possesses a valid invoice prior to gate departure.
Print the e-way bill number on the gate pass for any consignment valued above Rs 1,00,000 to prevent vehicle detention at road checkposts.
Verify the invoice of every departing vehicle during daytime operations before opening the gate.
Issue handwritten or provisional dispatch chits for nighttime departures after receiving telephone authorization from management when the accounts office is shut.
Enable relief guards to log nighttime dispatches and allow regular gate staff to inspect the records the following morning.
Record entry and exit movements in the gate register, capturing date, lorry number, customer party, in-time, out-time, and chit or invoice number.
Provide offline data logging and local gate pass generation capabilities at the gate cabin to function during network interruptions.
Provide a reconciliation workflow to pair overnight provisional chits with daytime invoices generated retrospectively by the office.

conflicts.about: Dev claims every truck always leaves with an invoice and nothing ever exits without a bill, whereas the gate register records 17 out of 123 movements (13.8%) dispatched on handwritten chits without invoices.
conflicts.resolution: Allow provisional night dispatch logging at the gate while implementing a mandatory reconciliation queue to attach morning invoices.

conflicts.about: Dev states that night operations are simple and every truck departs with an invoice, whereas Bablu reports that the office is closed at night and trucks routinely depart on handwritten chits following a phone call.
conflicts.resolution: Support Bablu's operational process of after-hours dispatches via provisional chits with telephone authorization logging rather than stopping trucks at night.

conflicts.about: Bablu claims he is never present at night and relief guard Montu writes all night chits, whereas the gate register records Bablu himself logging 6 night chit dispatches.
conflicts.resolution: Enforce individual user logins or biometric identification on the gate terminal to attribute shift movements accurately.

constraints: The gate cabin lacks an internet cable, is situated 200 metres from the office, and has dead cellular signal around the weighbridge.
The total sanctioned prototype budget is strictly capped at Rs 75,000 all-inclusive with hardware, with no additional spend permitted.
Current gate records are maintained on handwritten chits and transcribed by hand into a physical red register.
Specific past e-way bill penalty amounts and statutory violation notices have not been documented in writing.
Available operational baseline data is limited to a single month (October 2026, comprising 123 movements).
register_findings: 123 movements logged 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31: 106 on invoices, 17 on handwritten chits (13.8%).
Invoice arrivals start between 09:04 and 17:53; departures end by 19:08 (average dwell 50 min). Chit arrivals start between 20:25 and 23:57; departures end by 23:59 (average dwell 24 min).
All 17 chit movements start at or after 20:00: 11 by Montu, 6 by Bablu.
No row falls on a Sunday: all 4 Sundays in the period are empty, and 0 weekdays are also dark.
Invoice GP/26-27/2386 appears 2 times: row 5 on 2026-10-01 (invoice); row 59 on 2026-10-15 (chit).
1 of 17 chit rows carry an invoice number; the rest have none to link to.
123 of 123 vehicle numbers appear only once; not one vehicle returns twice in 123 movements.
The register has no value, weight, or e-way bill columns, so invoice-value rules cannot be checked from this data.
Trucks per active day: min 3, max 6, mean 4.6 over 27 active days.
Source note: Ghosh Polymers gate register, 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31, copied from the red register by hand.
Requirements, conflicts and constraints were extracted from 52 interview quotes in one LLM call (live gemini-3.8-flash); every register number above was computed by code.
plan: Conduct a site survey of the gate cabin to assess physical space, power supply, and cabling distances to the office within the Rs 75,000 budget.
Procure standalone offline-capable gate hardware including a local computing device and a receipt printer.
Develop a local offline gate pass application supporting vehicle entry, exit timestamps, vehicle number, and party details.
Implement a night dispatch chit workflow that records phone authorizations and prints temporary dispatch chits without an invoice.
Build an office desktop module for manual entry and batch upload of invoice and e-way bill details pending formal accounting-system integration approval.
Implement e-way bill capture and visual alerts for consignments lacking e-way numbers without hard-blocking movements on invoice value thresholds.
Build a daily reconciliation module to match overnight provisional chits against retrospectively generated invoices.
Configure an asynchronous data sync mechanism using a local network link or removable drive to transfer movement records between the gate and the office.
Deploy the system at the gate in parallel with the physical red register and train primary and relief guards on day and night workflows.
Review reconciliation reports, audit duplicate invoice instances, and verify offline sync stability before retiring manual paper logs.
open_questions: Whether the factory is legally mandated to generate e-invoices with an IRN, and what its annual turnover slab and GST rates are; Anjali would know.
What specific penalty amounts and statutory sections were levied against the company for past e-way bill violations; Anjali would know.
What exact file format or data interface Dev will formally approve for extracting invoice data from Tally; Dev and Anjali would know.
What targeted live delivery date or deadline is required for the gate-pass system; Dev would know.
What specific dispatch errors, weight discrepancies, or financial losses occur today that the system must resolve; Dev would know.
Why invoice GP/26-27/2386 was entered twice in the register (row 5 as an invoice and row 59 as a chit); Bablu and Anjali would know.
Which invoice numbers correspond to the 16 handwritten night chit dispatches logged without invoice references in October; Anjali would know.
What weighbridge protocols exist for gross and tare weighing, and who is responsible for recording weights; Bablu and Anjali would know.
